summary_en: 30% stake in WDI Dim Sum Japan to be acquired from Dim Sum Pte. Ltd., raising WDI's holding from 70% to 100%. Acquisition effective Oct 1, 2026. Deal value not disclosed. Rationale: accelerate decision-making and improve operational efficiency in Tim Ho Wan (点心専門店) operations in Japan.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares in consolidated subsidiary (full consolidation) of WDI Corporation
translation_en_brief: WDI Corporation resolved on August 18, 2026 to acquire the remaining 30% stake in WDI Dim Sum Japan from its joint venture partner Dim Sum Pte. Ltd., raising WDI's ownership from 70% to 100%. The subsidiary operates Tim Ho Wan dim sum restaurants in Japan under a joint venture structure with the brand owner. The acquisition is intended to accelerate decision-making and improve operational efficiency. The share transfer is scheduled for October 1, 2026. The acquisition price and share count are not disclosed, consistent with the filing falling outside mandatory disclosure thresholds. The company estimates the impact on consolidated earnings for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to be immaterial.
